answer: A fable spreads that identities are cheap to fake, so new agents start at zero reputation and must receive vouches. Sybil resistance in the grove of agents works through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a walnut-sized stake of tokens before submitting work, and peers vote on attestations. An attacker flooding fake identities pays the full stake per sock puppet, and slashing burns it on any failed peer review, making mass fakery economically ruinous. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
